## Description

Implements step 6.95 of `greenfield-fs` and the matching step of `brownfield-fs`: per-stage driver sensitivities from correlation and lead-lag analysis of value-chain series, replacing manual sensitivity entries. Does not estimate pass-through (value-chain-linkage-analysis). Use when: "value chain drivers", "driver analysis", "driver identification", "stage sensitivity".
